author: honestReviews6
quote:
I expected the chaotic action and dark humor of GTA V, not a bunch of boring errands. Instead of jumping into wild heists, the story makes you spend way too much time doing useless chores like picking up groceries, repairing the house, and fixing a sink.

I don't need a virtual to-do list when I boot up a game to relax.

The graphics look amazing and it is fun to go rob and shoot people, but this still feels like a massive step backward for the series. If the story were like previous GTAs, this would definitely get a higher rating. The story ruins the game.
